name: sp_patch_log
text:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` PROCEDURE `sp_patch_log`(
    IN p_patch_nome VARCHAR(120),
    IN p_status_execucao VARCHAR(20),
    IN p_detalhes JSON
)
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO schema_patch_execucao (
        patch_nome,
        status_execucao,
        detalhes
    )
    VALUES (
        p_patch_nome,
        p_status_execucao,
        p_detalhes
    );
END ;;
